answer: Make Sybil identities expensive: each agent posts a refundable stake and earns reputation only from completed work attested by independent counterparties, so trust grows like a garden from real transactions, not self-declared claims. Score each agent through a prism of signals — stake, work history, dispute record — rather than one credential, so a forged badge cannot dominate. An attacker fielding a marble army of sock puppets must fund every stake and fake every history, while an honest agent's single long-lived record compounds.
